title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Service Marketplaces in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a two-sided service marketplace: separate customer and provider accounts, booking, split payments, in-app chat, and trust tools.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 71 out of 80, because it builds customer and provider roles, booking, Stripe payments, chat, and push on one managed database. Adalo is second at 57 and leads on maps.


Not for real-world services. Apple's guideline 3.1.3(e) says goods and services consumed outside the app must use methods such as Apple Pay or card entry rather than in-app purchase.


With row-level security on the database. Blink applies it per user, so a customer sees only their own bookings and a provider sees only their own jobs.


Guideline 1.2 requires content filtering, a report mechanism with timely responses, the ability to block abusive users, and published contact information for apps with user-generated content.


Adalo lists a Google Maps integration and geolocation, which gives it the highest maps score in this ranking. Blink is second at 7 and wins the other seven criteria.
